provenance.note: One rotation phase of the treatment. Planting, harvest and irrigation events come from the stacked generator output, assigned to this phase by the plot ids in the Century package; planting amounts are still the generator's prior fills (prior_filled). Plantings, harvests and alfalfa cuttings the operation logs lack, including all of 2014, are filled from plot_system.csv and the cutting samples. Harvests take the harvest lookup fractions (harvest_lookup_row), alfalfa cuttings leave the stand alive, and cover crops and sudangrass go wholly to litter. Dates and amounts no record gives are imputed (provenance_class imputed) as described in tools/event_prep/README.md. Fertilization is rebuilt from the package; a season with no record, of a crop the treatment fertilizes in at least half its seasons, copies the treatment's nearest same-crop season with records (a fertilization gap). Tillage events are the operations Tautges et al. 2019 describe, one event each, timed and sized from medians of the monitoring tillage product within 25 km of Russell Ranch, 2016-2023 (calibration:runs/russell_ranch/events_treatments/monitoring_tillage_near_russell.csv).
